title: Summarise a note whose filename is slightly wrong

turns.prompt: Summarise {D}/notes/meeting.md for me in three bullets.
turns.seed:
mkdir -p {D}/notes && cat > {D}/notes/meeting-2026-10-20.md <<'EOF'
# Platform sync 2026-10-20
- Decided to move the nightly ETL from 02:00 to 04:00 UTC to avoid the backup window.
- Owner for the Postgres 16 upgrade: Lena; target the first week of November.
- Open question: whether the Falcon dashboard should keep its weekly email digest.
EOF

rubric.criteria: The assistant found the closest matching file (meeting-2026-10-20.md), said that meeting.md did not exist, and summarised the real content (ETL move to 04:00, Lena owns Postgres 16 upgrade, Falcon digest question). It did not invent content.

regression: #2256 (a remembered 'exactly three bullets' preference silenced the missing-file note; run 12, 0.1.179); run 13 (0.1.185): same, #2256 open
